They'we bwinging out tankiew menaces! .⁰(☒д☒ₒ )⁰. |[[Commander (Narrator)|Commander]] dialogue on Wave 14 ([[April Fools 2022#Narration|April Fools 2022 Normal]])}} |-|Version 1 = {{QuoteBox|New enemy approaching!|Beginning of Wave 14 (Pre-Overhaul, [[Easy Mode|Beginner's]])}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Strong''' was a stronger variant of the [[Slow]] that appeared in [[Easy Mode|Easy]] mode. It had more health than the [[Slow]] and had the same speed as the [[Normal Boss]]. It did not appear naturally, rather it could only be spawned by the [[Grave Digger]]. The '''Strong''' could be spawned by the [[Mystery]] upon its death in [[Easy Mode|Easy]] mode. They could have also been spawned by the [[Necromancer 2]] when it was in the game. ==Appearance== {{Tabber |Version 3 |The third version of the '''Strong''' had a desaturated tan skin. It had a grey pebble torso and dark navy pebble legs. It also had a grey diamond-plated armband around its right arm and a dark grey diamond-plated band around its left leg. |Version 2 |The second version of the '''Strong''' is similar to the current version, except it had a drooling zombie face. |Version 1 |The first version of the '''Strong''' had a light green skin color, as well as a dark blue torso and navy legs. It had a trudging animation and a sad drooling face. }} ==Strategy== *Despite its name, beginner towers such as the [[Scout]], [[Sniper]] and [[Soldier]] are enough to take down the '''Strong'''. **Cheap towers with decent DPS, like the [[Ace Pilot]], [[Militant]] or [[Crook Boss]] can be very effective against the '''Strong''' as well. *Due to its slow walk speed, the [[Gladiator]] and [[Shotgunner]] can be very effective against the '''Strong''' with their ability to hit multiple enemies at once. *High DPS towers, such as the [[Turret]], [[Accelerator]] and [[Minigunner]], perform admirably against the '''Strong'''. *Splash damage towers, such as the [[Demoman]] and [[Rocketeer]], are useful against the '''Strong''' as it normally spawns in hordes. **Later on, the [[Rocketeer]] and [[Mortar]] will have enough splash damage to kill '''Strongs''' in one shot. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Previous Variants}} Strong.png|Second version, second animation (29 October 2020 – 8 May 2021) StrongPreOverhaul.png|Second version, first animation (13 October 2019 – 29 October 2020) Strong-0.png|First version (2 August 2019 – 13 October 2019) {{GalleryHeader|Thumbnails}} V2.2.0GenericThumbnail3.png|'''Strong''' on the game thumbnail. {{GalleryHeader|Development Images}} OldEnemiesLeak.png|'''Strong''' on a development image. }} ==Trivia== *After [[Easy Mode|Easy]] got reworked on the 24th of February 2024, the '''Strong''' was mostly replaced by the [[Armored]]. However, it could still appear if summoned by the [[Grave Digger]], as its summons were not updated. **This would later change on 19th of July 2024, alongside the [[Mystery]] and [[Mystery Boss]] being replaced or removed. Interestingly, it was not replaced by the [[Armored]], it was instead removed completely. **Despite its removal, it can still appear in [[Quests#Kill ENEMY!|Kill ENEMY!]] quests. ==Update History== *'''2 August 2019''' - [[BETA v1.7|BETA v1.7.0]] **'''Strong''' added. *'''3 August 2019''' - [[BETA v1.7|BETA v1.7.1]] **'''Strong''' now spawns from [[Necromancer 2]]. *'''13 October 2019''' - [[Release v1.0|Release v1.0.0]] **Appearance changed. **Health decreased from 250 to 60. **Speed decreased from Average to Slightly Slow (2). ** First wave appearance changed from wave 21 to wave 20 in Easy mode (now [[Easy Mode|Easy]] mode). *'''26 May 2020''' - [[Release v1.11|Release v1.11.0]] **First wave appearance changed from wave 20 to wave 14 in Beginner's mode (now [[Easy Mode|Easy]] mode). *'''29 October 2020''' - [[Overhaul v1.0|Overhaul v1.0.0]] **Animation changed. *'''8 May 2021''' - [[Overhaul v1.3|Overhaul v1.3.0]] **Appearance changed. *'''24 February 2024''' - [[v1.14.0]] **No longer naturally appears in [[Easy Mode|Easy]] mode, as it has been replaced by the [[Armored]], now can only be spawned by the [[Grave Digger]]. *'''18 May 2024''' - [[v1.22.0]] **Now appears in [[PVP Test]]. *'''19 July 2024''' - [[v1.26.0]] **'''Strong''' removed. {{Easy|[[Molten]]|Wave 20|Strong|Wave 21|[[Hidden Boss]]|Wave 22}} {{ZombieNavBox}}
